description: Every service a CodeGene project can connect to: what it is for, its official logo (an SVG and a PNG address, or null when CodeGene has none), how the person connects it (signing in at the service, a key, or a server's details), the settings you may collect in chat, and the secrets the person types on CodeGene's page. Read it before connect_service.
name: list_connectable_services
title: Services you can connect
